caption:
Student loan delinquencies are hitting credit scores hard. 📉

FICO's latest analysis found borrowers with a recent student-loan delinquency saw scores fall by 38 points on average over the year (about 3.2 million consumers with a payment due).

New York Fed data also shows student-loan serious delinquency flows are being distorted as defaulted loans get re-reported.

If this is you, contact your servicer early and check your reports.

Has a student loan affected your score?
